text:
olivia: FYI noticed a surge of 'quota_mismatch' alerts after we flipped the v2 deprecation banner for 3% of tenants.
ben: saw that too — dashboards show traffic routed to v1 but accounting to v2? :thinking:
ajay: can you paste the logs? I'm not seeing route header in the billing logs.
olivia: short snippet:
```
[2024-06-21T14:07:12Z] tenant=acme route_header= v2_flag=on billing_token="tkn_..." route=pin:v1
```
ben: aha — header gets stripped in edge proxy for banner requests.
maria: that explains why console shows v2 adopters but backend counts v1 usage. we need a durable version signal for billing.
ajay: proposal: add `x-rw-version-source: client|banner|console` and have billing prefer explicit source. small schema change, backwards compatible.
olivia: 👌 also add an aggregated gauge `version_attribution.delta` for rollout cohorts.
ben: will need a console change too — deck should show cohort-level attribution and expected delta.
maria: ops question: do we patch proxy to preserve existing header? risk of breaking older clients.
ajay: safer to add new header at edge when banner is shown; leave existing behavior for clients.
olivia: rollout plan: canary edge change -> add header for banner requests -> update billing to prefer new header -> run 24h sanity -> ship console UX.
ben: can we add a temporary alert on `abs(version_attribution.delta) > 5%` for 24h after canary?
maria: yes, and we'll tag events in the audit log with `deprec-banner=true`.
olivia: I'll open a PR with the header name and dashboard mocks. tagging @ajay @ben for review.
deploy-bot: deploy queued — canary to 2 nodes in us-west at 1717112500 :rocket:
ajay: thanks — monitoring hooks in progress.
ben: leaving notes in the rollout doc.
olivia: thanks team, will follow up tomorrow w/ results :thumbsup:
